name: One Workspace
description: Open your apps and manage your workspace in one place.

name: Drive
description: Browse, upload, organise and share your files.

name: Docs
description: Create and edit documents, spreadsheets and presentations.

name: Photos
description: Browse your pictures and explore folders as albums.

name: Music
description: Listen to your own music collection.

name: Git
description: Keep code projects organised and work on them together.

name: MyAccounts
description: Manage your account and the people who can sign in.

name: Photo Editor
description: Crop, draw and edit images.

name: Mail
description: Read and send email from your workspace.

name: Calendar
description: Plan events and keep track of your schedule.

name: Contacts
description: Keep names, email addresses and phone numbers together.

name: Notes
description: Write notes and organise them into notebooks.

name: My Tube
description: Upload and watch videos, create channels and organise playlists.

name: Chat
description: Send messages, share files and chat in groups.

name: My Vault
description: Keep your passwords in a protected vault.

name: My Hosting
description: Publish and manage your websites.

name: My Tasks
description: Organise to-do lists, shared tasks and reminders.

name: My PDF
description: Read, annotate and organise PDF documents.

name: My Monitor
description: Check whether your apps and websites are running.

name: My Search
description: Find things across your connected apps.

name: Backups
description: Save copies of your workspace so you can recover your work.

name: My Slicer
description: Prepare 3D models for supported printers.

name: My Social
description: Share photos, stories and reels.

name: My Clips
description: Create, share and discover short videos.

name: My Maps
description: Explore maps, save places and plan routes.

name: My Meet
description: Host video meetings, share your screen and chat.

name: My Create
description: Create designs and edit imported text, shapes, pictures and pages.

name: My 3D
description: Build 3D models from shapes and dimensioned profiles, then export for printing.

name: My AI
description: Chat with AI models and build with your code projects.

name: My Cinema
description: Watch your movies and series with private family profiles.

name: My Push
description: Deliver private notifications to your linked phones.

name: My Shield
description: Review security signals and coverage for this Workspace.

name: My Forms
description: Create forms and quizzes, collect responses and keep them in My Drive.

name: My Finance
description: Plan household budgets, track spending and import bank statements.
